## Projects

### MediVault (2024)
AI-powered medical records platform. Features: NVIDIA NIM OCR for document digitisation, PyTorch/TrOCR for handwritten prescription parsing, WebRTC telemedicine video calls, blockchain-verified record integrity (Polygon), emergency paramedic QR access, ABHA ID integration, PostgreSQL + MinIO S3.
Live: https://medi-vault-seven-lyart.vercel.app/
Stack: Next.js, Node.js, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, MinIO S3, NVIDIA NIM, PyTorch, WebRTC, Polygon/Web3

### EcoVision Bharat (2024)
AI civic technology platform — YOLOv8 waste severity detection, citizen reporting, and government dashboard. GNA Hackathon 4.0 Domain Winner — Clean & Green Technology.
Stack: React, FastAPI, Python, PostgreSQL, YOLOv8

Full-Stack ML application — Scikit-learn placement readiness prediction + Google Gemini AI for ATS resume scoring.
